source_caption:
Now that Euphoria is officially over, looking back at the first two seasons feels bittersweet. Say what you want about the final chapter or the critiques around Season 3, but peak Euphoria was lightning in a bottle.This bathroom scene between Jacob Elordi and Sydney Sweeney is the perfect example of why those early seasons were untouchable.

With the broadcast of its final episode last night, HBO’s Euphoria officially concluded its three-season run. Over the last seven years, the series redefined contemporary television production from setting global beauty and fashion trends to pioneering distinctive visual cinematography under showrunner Sam Levinson.

source_details.synopsis: Euphoria is an American psychological drama television series created and written by Sam Levinson for HBO. Based on the Israeli miniseries of the same name created by Ron Leshem, the series stars Zendaya as drug-addicted teenager Rue Bennett, who also serves as an unreliable narrator. The ensemble cast includes Maude Apatow, Angus Cloud, Eric Dane, Alexa Demie, Jacob Elordi, Barbie Ferreira, Nika King, Storm Reid, Hunter Schafer, Algee Smith, Sydney Sweeney, Colman Domingo, Javon "Wanna" Walton, and Austin Abrams.
